maddeler.e:
نحيا (form I)
# نَحْيَا (naḥyā) /naħ.jaː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive of حَيَّ (ḥayya) and حَيِيَ (ḥayiya)
# نُحْيَا (nuḥyā) /nuħ.jaː/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of حَيَّ (ḥayya)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
